in_sanskrit.name: नन्दकिशोर
in_sanskrit.meaning: नन्द (new, joyful, blissful, delight) + किशोर (one who brings joy)
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: One who brings new joy, or One who is a source of joyful and blissful delight.

in_hindi.long_meaning: One who brings new joy, or One who is a source of joyful and blissful delight.

in_tamil.long_meaning: One who brings new joy, or One who is a source of joyful and blissful delight.

in_telugu.name: నందకిషోర్
in_telugu.meaning: నంద (దేహీ, చిత్తేశ్వర, అనేదన్యేశ్వర, అద్యృజ్యోత్స్యేశ్వర - new, joyful, blissful, delight) + కిషోర్ (చేదేదరి - one who brings joy)

in_marathi.name: Nandakishore
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Joy (Nanda) and Lord Kishor (Kishore)
in_marathi.long_meaning: Nandakishore हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Nandakishore is derived from Sanskrit roots, where Nanda means joy, bliss, or happiness. Kishore is a name of Lord Vishnu, meaning 'Lord of all things'. This name signifies the joy one experiences in the presence of the divine Lord.
